invariant_bindings.invariant_text: `can_retry()` MUST return True when total requests in the window is below `min_requests` (warm-up bypass).
After warm-up, `can_retry()` MUST return False iff `len(_retries) / len(_requests) > ratio` over the current window.
Samples older than `window_s` MUST be evicted on every record/check, so the decision is always based on the CURRENT rolling window.
